userOutcome: Editing saves without Save buttons or Review dialog. Add has no explanatory text in allowed contexts.

presentation: Remove Review changes dialog and routine Save changes, Save status/date/organization buttons.
Title and Notes remain single editor. Add retains one contextual empty-action operation.
Show compact Saving / Saved / Needs attention status; creation explanation hidden when allowed, disabled reason only when necessary.
Immediate flag/completion/status and Defer/date/organization controls save directly; cascade count/warnings can appear inline after result with Undo. No confirmation modal.

Rows display retained draft Title immediately; saved user data remains exact. Routine Unsaved badges, long proposal text, Saved comparison and ID/revision diagnostics are absent from primary UI. Comparison only appears for reconciliation/failure.
Empty list is one line. Static default filter summary is omitted; explicit active nondefault filters and saved Perspective definition remain visible for truthful selection semantics.
scheduling: Inject timer effect port; debounce valid draft changes for 500 ms. Blur and editor close/navigation flush due edits without destroying drafts. Composition pauses debounce; compositionend captures final input then schedules.

One owner-wide write lane processes action draft groups and direct commands serially. Each request gets its operation ID and current owner revision only at dispatch. In-flight payload/captured fields freeze; subsequent input remains editable and queues the latest proposal.

Autosave acknowledges only fields still equal to captured values, before full-snapshot acceptance, retaining newer corrections and other action/group proposals. Dirty equality to current saved values can be removed by pure planning, avoiding redundant writes.

Routine draft/direct transitions call existing preview_change for validation/resolved date/cascade warning data, immediately followed by apply_change without UI approval. Preview is not a reservation.

Debounce is only for text/number/date input; select/check discrete changes enqueue immediately. Invalid/incomplete numeric/date inputs remain visible and unsent with inline feedback; no repeated busy loop.
recovery: Unknown pauses the write lane while retaining exact request/operation ID/callback/captured fields and later drafts. Check/Retry replay the same request; no fresh mutation IDs until the result is definite. Navigation and Back/Close remain usable.
Editing can continue during ordinary saving, including other actions. Unknown retains proposal state; typing may remain available but persistence stays paused.

Definite validation keeps drafts and stops retries until its relevant input is corrected. Revision conflict refreshes latest state; touched-field overlap pauses for inline reconciliation, unrelated owner writes may resume safely with a bounded single refresh retry. No silent overwrite.

After unknown exact recovery, acknowledge frozen captured fields then process newer queued proposals at latest revision. Missing/deleted target stays unavailable with retained draft; no silent rebinding.
Before unload retains native unsaved-change protection. Debounce does not guarantee persistence if browser closes before request completion; close/navigation inside app flushes through the same lane.
creation: Add remains atomic context creation with receipt-derived generated ID and Title focus. Created clean route, disabled ambiguous/deferred-only contexts and exact unknown recovery are preserved.
ports: Pure autosave plan chooses group/payload/captured fields and input validity, without timers/DOM. Controller owns lane and acknowledgment; injected timer adapter owns scheduling.
DOM captures raw values/IME/focus and renders stable input nodes. Serialized factories remain closed; generated and built resources execute identical behavior.

Direct methods own a single controller write wrapper; DOM does not wrap a controller-owned action in another action() call. Commands queued during saving retain action ID and semantics, not an old expected revision.
conflicts: Draft first-edit captures persisted field baselines (Defer variants compare the saved defer_until). Subsequent full-snapshot acceptance checks touched persisted fields against those baselines, not merely owner revision. Unrelated owner writes do not pause the draft.

If an externally changed touched field differs from both baseline and proposed value, pause that target and expose minimal inline Use my edits / Use saved. Do not automatically rebase and save over it. Target deletion retains all fields and disables persistence.
Use my edits explicitly rebases retained values to the current full snapshot and queues normal save. Use saved discards only conflicted fields and leaves unrelated proposals intact. No routine modal.

Own successful acknowledgment updates remaining newer field baselines to the confirmed saved captured value before full snapshot merge, preventing our earlier write from masquerading as an external conflict.

Definite revision conflict fetches latest state then field checks decide whether an unrelated revision can resume safely or touched fields need reconciliation; each rejected request is definite and any later dispatch uses a new operation ID. No unbounded retry storm.

acceptance: Typing A, dispatch, then B before A response: input remains B; A acknowledgment cannot clear B; second serialized write saves B at latest revision.
IME intermediate input causes no write; final composition saves after debounce.
Blur/Back/navigation flush original target, retaining all nine fields and other actions; no dialog or Save button exists.
Unknown A plus later draft B: exact retry A selects same creation/action and later B saves once after confirmation.
Flag/complete/status/date changes issue existing preview/apply serially without modal; cascade and warnings remain observable inline and Undo available.
Malformed creation proof continues unknown; invalid raw inputs never written; definite revision conflict preserves proposal until explicit resume.
Allowed Add context shows no explanation; disabled Add has a concise reason.
